verdict.rationale: HumanLayer runs Claude Code and Codex sessions as tasks. Its workflows include Oneshot for small, clear changes and RPI with registered implementation sub-agents, and the session agent can open a draft PR, so agent-driven feature implementation through to a PR is documented. Nothing in the evidence mentions the agent writing or running tests, and there is no hands-on account of a full end-to-end feature delivery. Missing for 10: any documentation that tests are written or run as part of the workflow, and independent or hands-on corroboration of end-to-end feature delivery.
